title: [RODEN] A new Popup Walk, Lots of Books
content:
Roden Readers —
Ahoy from Crisptown, population: Everyone in Japan. The summer is done. Thank glorious gods be, the summer is done. (Mostly.) I can feel my brain starting to solidify again, returning to its natural state after three months of relentless broiled liquefaction.
In honor of sane mercury and humidity readings, I’m heading off on a 200-kilometer walk and running a pop-up newsletter: (the entire walk is) Between Two Mountains starts on October 2 (Which is today!
